Disgusting!
Jan 2026 • Couples
Unfortunately, the food and service did not live up to the glowing reviews from previous patrons.

We ordered skewers, fries, edamame, and a cucumber salad, but the timing was completely disjointed. The fries arrived 40 minutes before the skewers, the cucumber salad after 30 minutes, and the edamame after 20 minutes. We ordered another round of fries to come with the skewers, yet those also arrived before the skewers did.

One of the main draws of this restaurant was that the meat is meant to be served on a hot coal cooking tray. Ours arrived on a cold tray with the coal already burnt out. We were told the meat had been pre-cooked, which showed—it was overcooked and cold. The beer was warm, and the service was frosty throughout.

There were no redeeming qualities to our experience. In fact, we went back to double-check the name of the restaurant because we genuinely thought we must have chosen the wrong place compared to the reviews we had read.

Written January 10, 2026
Dreamer04919126354
Thank you for your review. I take feedback seriously, especially when it’s detailed.

I’ve personally reviewed the service timeline with the team on duty that evening. The fries, edamame, and cucumber salad were ordered separately and therefore served as they were ready. The second portion of fries was specifically requested to come with the skewer combo and was brought out just before the skewers, with the skewers following immediately after. While the timing may not have felt right from your seat, it wasn’t as delayed or disjointed as described. Still, if the flow felt off, that’s something we can and will improve.

As for the skewers and charcoal tray. Our standard is hot, fresh, and cooked to order. If the dish didn’t meet that expectation, then that’s on us, and I won’t make excuses for it. That’s not the experience we aim to deliver.

Service-wise, our team was attentive throughout the evening and checked in multiple times, including at the end of the meal. However, if the hospitality felt cold to you, I apologize, perception matters as much as intention.

We never want guests leaving confused or disappointed. If you’re willing to give us another chance, I’d be more than happy to make sure your next visit is done properly, the way it should be.

With all of respect,
Jayden
